messages:
Sam (People Ops): FYI Carlos submitted resignation today, last day 2026-06-10. Opening offboard thread for benefits cutoff, asset return, access removal, and exit interview scheduling. Please claim tasks.

Lina (Eng Manager): Noted. I'll collect a short handoff doc and schedule a 30m shadow session on 6/08. Can we freeze his Slack to read-only on 6/10 20:00 PT?

Otto (IT): I'll do credential sweep and reclaim licenses. Proposed timeline:
- Now: revoke console admin keys
- 2026-06-10 20:00 PT: disable interactive logins
- 2026-06-11 09:00 PT: rotate any service keys after handoff confirmed
I will attach audit to ticket OFFBOARD-5032.

Nina (Security): Please check for shared deploy keys or CI tokens referencing carlos@redwood.ai. If found, rotate before 6/11. I'll capture the audit trail for compliance.

Payroll Bot: Reminder: benefits cut-off 2026-06-10 23:59 PT. COBRA packet to be issued within 14 days. Confirm mailing address in HR profile. Final pay will include accrued PTO per policy.

Facilities: Carlos will return MacBook + dongle. Available drop-off 6/11-6/13 09:00-16:00. Keycard will be disabled 6/11 09:00 unless manager requests extension.

Sam (People Ops): Action list recap:
- Otto: audit, revoke admin keys, rotate SA keys after handoff
- Lina: schedule handoff 6/08 + remove repo deploy key for infra if not needed
- Nina: audit logs and confirm rotations
- Payroll: send COBRA packet within 14 days
- Facilities: receive laptop 6/11-6/13
- Sam: schedule exit interview (proposing 6/12 10:30 PT)

Lina (Eng Manager): 6/08 14:00 for handoff works. 6/12 10:30 PT for exit interview ok. I'll confirm which repos still need his deploy key and remove remaining keys after 6/08.

Otto (IT): OFFBOARD-5032 created. Revoked admin keys and listing licenses reclaimed. Will update when SA rotations complete.

Nina (Security): I'll run a final sweep after asset return and close the security checklist.

Sam (People Ops): Thanks all  marking this thread as canonical. I'll post closure note when OFFBOARD-5032 is complete.
